summary_en: Marubun updated its capital cost and stock price-conscious management framework initially announced in November 2023, analyzing current progress and revising its approach for sustainable value creation.

doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase)
doc_title_jp: 配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 通期連結業績予想の上方修正に基づく配当性向50%またはDOE 3.5%のいずれか高い方の基本方針に沿った修正

summary_en: Marubun raised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast by 23 yen to 62 yen per share, bringing the full-year dividend to 100 yen per share with an estimated payout ratio of 50.5%. The increase follows an upward revision of consolidated earnings guidance.
summary_jp: 通期業績予想の上方修正に伴い、2027年3月期の期末配当予想を前回から23円増の62円に修正。年間配当は100円となり、連結配当性向は50.5%の見込み。
